profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
HJKL IYKYK

My profile is a gift of reprieve to those dredging through hundreds of vague statements of experience and skill with bloodshot eyes. You're welcome. On a more serious note, I'm passionate about helping students/early career navigate the tech industry - leave me a message if you want to chat about my (or your) experiences.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- I work on mobile test infrastructure for Meet!
- I was coding in Python, then Kotlin, then Java, then C++ for a week, and now Java
- Fun fact, I've switched tech stacks once every 3 months for the past 2 years
- I'm not quite sure what I'm allowed to write here tbh
- between you and me, I still barely understand how most things work around here

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Slack bots Slack bots Slack bots
    - Slack bot for managing incidents
    - Slack bot for managing Slack app requests and basically replacing the native process
        - convinced Slack to build this API endpoint: https://api.slack.com/methods/admin.apps.clearResolution
    - Slack bot for automatic fielding of support questions with the magic of Watson Assistant
    - My Magnum Opus: A bad Flappy Bird clone that runs in Slack
- Javascript makes my hands shaky
- Why are MongoDB queries so verbose
- I love Typescript
- Launched an org-wide dev guild 
- Mentoring interns and peers

positions.title: Backend Chapter Lead
positions.description:
- Drive the vision and execution of backend .NET development at Spreetail
- Led the charge into the microservice bandwagon. Still working on it. 
- Sniff out and finger-waggle at systemic flaws in our code, processes, and approach to software
- Create training material for new hires and interns. Convince interns that software engineering is really a good life choice.
- Bleed on the bleeding edge of technology so others don't have to
- Lead small team of mercenary developers and stomp on tough problems

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Develop new features and fix bugs for Warehouse Operations and internal websites

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
-Develop a dashboard prototype for WPF application
-Implement WCF pub/sub services for pushing notifications to client
-Make high-level application design decisions about overall application implementation details following a general design document

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: I worked with the Web Solutions team to correct defects in complex, client-facing web applications and to rewrite and optimize an older webform application using the MVC pattern in ASP.NET.

positions.title: Quality Assurance
positions.description:
- Write automated unit tests using PhantomJS and CasperJS
- Manually test incoming branches
- Full regression tests
